Typhoon Haiyan approaches as about 30,000 residents are told to evacuate
Local authorities said six people were injured in the floodwaters and tens of thousands of households lost power.

Rescue teams reached the disaster zone at 2:30 a.m. on Tuesday and have so far evacuated 1,200 people.

The meteorological department warned that rainfall could reach 250 millimetres over the next 24 hours.
